description: This file defines the NodePairingApprovalPrompter class, which manages the user interface and logic for approving or rejecting node pairing requests within the application. It handles fetching pairing requests, presenting prompts, processing user responses, remote resolutions, and silent approval via SSH. It encapsulates the entire node pairing approval workflow, including network communication, user notifications, and app state management.

classes.name: NodePairingApprovalPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing node pairing approval UI prompts, handling pairing request lifecycle, network communication, and user notifications.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the pairing prompt cycle and starts the reconciliation loop.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing prompting, cancels tasks, and resets the state.

methods.name: loadPendingRequestsFromGateway
methods.description: Loads pending pairing requests from the gateway, with retries on startup.

methods.name: reconcileLoop
methods.description: Periodically synchronizes pairing requests with the gateway to ensure consistency.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Processes a list of pairing requests and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: presentNextIfNeeded
methods.description: Presents the next pairing prompt if none are currently being displayed.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays a user prompt for a pairing request.

methods.name: handleAlertResponse
methods.description: Handles user's response to the pairing prompt and performs approval or rejection.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Sends approval for a pairing request to the gateway.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Sends rejection for a pairing request to the gateway.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Generates a descriptive text for a pairing request.

methods.name: prettyIP
methods.description: Formats IP address string for display.

methods.name: prettyPlatform
methods.description: Formats platform string for display.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a user notification about pairing resolution.

methods.name: trySilentApproveIfPossible
methods.description: Attempts silent approval of a pairing request via SSH if applicable.

methods.name: resolveSSHTarget
methods.description: Determines SSH target details for silent approval.

methods.name: probeSSH
methods.description: Probes SSH connectivity to a target host.

methods.name: updateReconcileLoop
methods.description: Adjusts the reconciliation loop based on current state.

methods.name: updatePendingCounts
methods.description: Updates the counts of pending requests for UI display.

methods.name: scheduleReconcileOnce
methods.description: Schedules a single reconciliation attempt after a delay.

methods.name: handleResolved
methods.description: Handles a remote resolution (approval/rejection) of a pairing request.
